text.tspan: Kaya identity: drivers of CO₂ emissions World
Percentage change in the four parameters of the Kaya Identity, which determine total CO₂ emissions. Emissions
from fossil fuels and industry are included. Land-use change emissions are not included.

tspan.tspan: Global Carbon Budget (2025) and other sources
GDP per capita is measured in 2011 international-$ (PPP). This adjusts for inflation and cross-country price differences.
